ui.title: BRASSREEL: Clockwork Siege

scrap_bot.name: Scrap Bot

cog_knight.name: Guard Bot

cog_bulwark.name: Bastion Bot

cog_ramhead.name: Ram Bot

cog_fortress_golem.name: Fortress Mech

cog_aegis_bastion.name: Aegis Mech

cog_steam_juggernaut.name: Jugger Mech

cog_siegebreaker.name: Siege Mech

spring_archer.name: Arrow Bot

spring_repeater.name: Rapid Bot

spring_clockwork_ballista.name: Ballista Mech

spring_eagle_sentinel.name: Eagle Mech

spring_volley_array.name: Volley Mech

spring_chrono_marksman.name: Chrono Mech

fuse_sapper.name: Fuse Bot

fuse_pyromancer.name: Flame Bot

fuse_magma_mortar.name: Mortar Mech

fuse_doom_barricade.name: Barrier Mech

coil_sparker.name: Spark Bot

coil_conduit.name: Wire Bot

coil_dynamo.name: Dynamo Bot

coil_tesla_titan.name: Tesla Mech

coil_storm_conductor.name: Storm Mech

coil_shield_galvanizer.name: Shield Mech

coil_overload_core.name: Overload Mech

steam_leviathan.name: Leviathan Mech
steam_leviathan.desc: Legendary dreadnought: soaks hits and returns part of the damage.

solarion_sun_forge.name: Solarion Mech
solarion_sun_forge.desc: Focuses a concentrated continuous beam melting enemy armor.

chrono_warden.name: Chrono Warden Mech
chrono_warden.desc: Bends time on the field: every enemy walks slower.

scrapper.name: Scrap Marauder
scrapper.desc: Nimble scavenger armed with rusted blades.

shield_drone.name: Shield Drone

piston_hound.name: Piston Hound
piston_hound.desc: High-speed quadruped leaping past frontline defenders.

spire_golem.name: Spire Golem
spire_golem.desc: Towering iron construct shaking the battlefield.

boiler_raider.name: Boiler Raider
boiler_raider.desc: Elite saboteur accelerating toward the Boiler.

acid_drone.name: Acid Drone

rust_creeper.name: Rust Creeper

bog_stalker.name: Bog Stalker

toxic_leech.name: Toxic Leech
toxic_leech.desc: Parasitic siphon draining defender combat pressure.

clockwork_executioner.name: Clockwork Executioner
clockwork_executioner.desc: Twin-bladed elite automaton slicing through frontlines.

siege_engine.name: Citadel Siege Engine

dreadnought.name: Citadel Dreadnought

lightning_spire.name: Lightning Spire

scrap_collector.name: Scrap Collector

spark_plug.name: Spark Plug

spiked_plating.name: Spiked Plating

arc_repeater.name: Arc Repeater

cleaving_blade.name: Cleaving Blade

supercharged_coil.name: Supercharged Coil

chain_lightning.name: Voltaic Cascade
chain_lightning.desc: Chain lightning arcs through massive enemy clusters

lucky_cam.name: Lucky Cam

pressure_valve.name: Pressure Valve

diagonal_dynamo.name: Diagonal Dynamo
diagonal_dynamo.desc: Diagonal paylines summon units 1 Tier higher.

hollow_spring.name: Hollow Spring
hollow_spring.desc: Pairs have a 25% chance to summon a Tier 1 unit instead of Scrap.

steam_forge.name: Steam Forge
steam_forge.desc: +1 Steam per wave; all units deal +15% damage in Overdrive.

brass_ratchet.name: Brass Ratchet
brass_ratchet.desc: Gain +1 extra Nudge charge per wave.

gilded_flywheel.name: Gilded Flywheel
gilded_flywheel.desc: Gilded symbols appear in shop at 50% discount.

furnace_bellows.name: Furnace Bellows
furnace_bellows.desc: Smelt grants +1 extra XP when Heat is above 50%.

chain_cam.name: Chain Cam
chain_cam.desc: Golden Gear (Wild) on the center slot counts for all 8 paylines.

scrap_boiler.name: Scrap Boiler
scrap_boiler.desc: Sacrificing a Scrap Bot heals the Boiler for +1 HP.

clockwork_relay.name: Clockwork Relay
clockwork_relay.desc: Each extra line hit reduces unit attack cooldowns by 10%.

overdrive_clutch.name: Overdrive Clutch
overdrive_clutch.desc: Jams no longer damage units; jammed reels unlock faster.

cog_catalyst.name: Cog Catalyst
cog_catalyst.desc: Cog units gain +25% HP and taunt nearby enemies.

spring_barrel.name: Spring Barrel
spring_barrel.desc: 3 Spring symbols on a line summon 2 Spring units.

coil_resonator.name: Coil Resonator
coil_resonator.desc: Coil lightning arcs bounce to +2 additional targets.

grand_regulator.name: Grand Regulator
grand_regulator.desc: Scoring a Jackpot awards +50 Cogs and +2 Steam.

perpetual_cam.name: Perpetual Cam
perpetual_cam.desc: Unused Hold charges carry over between waves (max 4).

sharpening_stone.name: Precision Scope

copper_coil.name: Superconductor

steam_gauge.name: Heavy Regulator
steam_gauge.desc: Heat cools down by an extra 20% between waves.

lucky_coin.name: Tarnished Coin
lucky_coin.desc: Adds a wild symbol to every reel.

pressure_spring.name: Recoil Buffer

insulated_gloves.name: Safety Grip
insulated_gloves.desc: Jams no longer lock a reel.

cog_wrench.name: Forge Wrench
cog_wrench.desc: Every merge gives the robot +1 random mod.

lens_array.name: Prismatic Lens
lens_array.desc: +15% critical hit chance for all robots.

reinforced_boiler.name: Steel Rivets

golden_key.name: Master Key

chrono_gear.name: Chrono Gear

scrap_magnet.name: Scrap Compactor

overcharge_vial.name: Nitro Injector
overcharge_vial.desc: Next battle: robots deal double damage for the first 8 seconds.

repair_kit.name: Boiler Patch
repair_kit.desc: Instantly +2 boiler pressure (up to the maximum).

bribe_token.name: Smuggler's Mark
bribe_token.desc: Restocks the shelf with permanent upgrades only.

sentry_kit.name: Portable Turret

shock_grenade.name: Stun Mine
shock_grenade.desc: Next battle: the first 3 enemies are stunned for 4 seconds.

golden_ticket.name: Gilded Stamp
golden_ticket.desc: Gilds a random symbol on the center reel.

corrosion_empress.name: Corrosion Empress
corrosion_empress.desc: Sovereign of the Rust Swamps dissolving metal with toxic bile.

iron_colossus.name: The Iron Colossus
iron_colossus.desc: Ultimate fortress-breaker automaton powered by triple boilers.

scrap_plating.name: Scrap Plating
scrap_plating.desc: 20% chance to gain +1 cog on hit.

fortress_barricade.name: Fortress Barricade
fortress_barricade.desc: Every 8 s shields itself and neighbours for 25% of its health.

damage_reflection.name: Damage Reflection
damage_reflection.desc: Returns 30% of damage taken to the attacker.

impact_charge.name: Impact Charge
impact_charge.desc: Every 3rd hit stuns the target for 1.5 s (bosses 0.5 s).

siege_cleave.name: Siege Cleave
siege_cleave.desc: Hits also strike enemies in adjacent lanes for 40% damage.

recoil_spring.name: Recoil Spring
recoil_spring.desc: 20% chance to ricochet into a second enemy for 60% damage.

infinite_pierce.name: Piercing Bolt
infinite_pierce.desc: Shots pierce up to 3 enemies in the lane.

triple_burst.name: Triple Burst
triple_burst.desc: Every shot adds 2 bolts at random enemies for 40% damage each.

focus_acceleration.name: Focus Acceleration
focus_acceleration.desc: +10% attack speed per hit on the same target (up to +100%).

death_explosion.name: Death Detonation
death_explosion.desc: Explodes on death for triple its damage within 1.5 tiles.

molten_pool.name: Molten Pool
molten_pool.desc: Sets the target and enemies around it on fire: 40% damage per second for 4 s.

thermal_vulnerability.name: Thermal Vulnerability

concussive_knockback.name: Concussive Blast

proximity_mines.name: Point-Blank Blast

electric_conduction.name: Conduction

five_fold_chain.name: Five-Fold Chain
five_fold_chain.desc: Lightning jumps to 4 more enemies for 75% damage and shock.

thunderbolt_strike.name: Thunderbolt

kinetic_shield_aura.name: Kinetic Shield Aura

steam_shroud.name: Steam Shroud

solar_beam.name: Solar Beam
solar_beam.desc: Ignores half of the enemy's armor, +25% damage.

time_dilation.name: Time Dilation
time_dilation.desc: While alive, all enemies move 40% slower.

steam_aegis.name: Steam Aegis
steam_aegis.desc: Takes 20% less damage and returns 20% to the attacker.
